scope: retrospective adult T1D basal research, no clinical deployment
method: RL-DITR-inspired representation, action-conditioned dynamics, glucose/WTR heads; later SL plus model-based policy optimization
planning_horizon: separate from observation grid and action duration; selected only after patient-model multi-step validation
action: constant delivered basal-equivalent rate in U/h for the whole specified interval; not native command evidence and not injection dose
each_feature_encoding: observed-only train-standardized value or masked zero
log1p elapsed hours since record, capped at 24h
optional_mode: retrospective_multimodal adds recorded carbs and exercise counts; real-time entry availability unverified, not default policy input
imputation: none; tensor placeholders must always accompany masks; source NaNs unchanged
normalization: unique rows in histories of train 5min qualified targets, observed values only, no validation/test fitting
score: RL-DITR author glu2risk, mg/dL = mmol/L * 18; b<70:-1; otherwise 1-clip(10*(1.509*(ln(b)^1.084-5.381))^2,0,15.5)/7.75
reward_parenthesis_resolution: Author implementation and standard glucose-risk transform agree; printed Methods grouping would saturate normal glucose at -1, and is not used.
reward: sum over next actual CGMs of gamma_hour^(k*5/60)*score*5/60, left discount k=0..n-1
truncation: data qualification or action support boundary, not clinical termination; valid next-state bootstrap kept separate
future_cointerventions: separate outcome diagnostics; never part of current policy features; not automatically available in counterfactual rollouts
